While this model's a Best Buy exclusive, you'd pay $300 more for an equivalent TV from Samsung direct. OLED panels light each pixel individually, which is why this type of TV is known for deep blacks and strong contrast. My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). Deal ends November 8.
